quotes.text: Each lingering external account represents a blind spot, a place where oversight failed long before any attacker even tried to breach the system.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames forgotten guests as a governance failure, not just a technical detail.

quotes.text: A stale guest account already comes bundled with trust. It's anchored in your tenant, linked to a legitimate domain, and in many cases, already configured with approved access into teams, SharePoint, or other M three sixty five apps.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why attackers value stale guest accounts.

quotes.text: Ghosted guests bypass those barriers because they are insiders by definition, They've been explicitly allowed into your tenant at some point in the past.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp argument why forgotten guests can be more dangerous than external hackers.

quotes.text: Access ends when the project ends unless someone deliberately renews it. That's the core idea of life cycle management, and it flips the narrative from reactive cleanup to proactive control.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the core rule of guest lifecycle management.

quotes.text: Running a massive audit to delete stale accounts feels good for a moment the tenant looks clean, the numbers drop, and it can claim progress, But without continuous life cycle management, the sprawl starts again the next day.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Distinguishes one-time cleanup from sustainable lifecycle control.

chapters.title: Compliance nightmares: ISO, GDPR, least privilege

takeaways: Guest accounts in Microsoft 365 are easy to create but rarely removed, so most tenants hold far more forgotten external identities than admins expect.
Stale guests keep trusted access to Teams and SharePoint and break least-privilege requirements in frameworks like ISO 27001 and GDPR.
Automated expiration, recertification through access reviews and Conditional Access turn guest sprawl into a predictable, auditable lifecycle.
hook: Every contractor or partner you ever invited into Microsoft 365 may still have access today. This episode helps admins and security leads uncover forgotten guest accounts, understand the security and compliance risk, and set up a guest lifecycle with expiration and access reviews.
